analogy.rationale: Thymidylate synthase inhibitors block de novo dTMP synthesis, causing nucleotide imbalance and DNA replication stress; dihydrofolate reductase inhibitors and other DNA synthesis inhibitors converge on the same thymidine nucleotide pool, while ribonucleotide reductase and DNA polymerase inhibitors impair the same downstream DNA replication program.
